title: Wallet Ledger (examples/ledger)
summary: Single-writer wallet ledger event loop, state mutations, sinks, declared invariants, and the nil-amount crash site.

groups.title: Inputs
groups.plain: Wallet events read from events.jsonl or Kafka

groups.title: State & Sinks
groups.plain: In-memory ledger balances, net total, and emitted outputs

groups.title: Invariants
groups.plain: Rules checked by the Kavach SDK after every ok step

nodes.title: deposit
nodes.plain: Credits an account and increases Net by amount.

nodes.title: withdraw
nodes.plain: Checks funds, debits account, and decreases Net.

nodes.title: transfer
nodes.plain: Moves amount from sender to recipient without changing Net.

nodes.title: Ledger.Handle
nodes.plain: Decodes JSON Event, reads env.Now(), and dispatches deposit/withdraw/transfer.

nodes.title: Ledger.post
nodes.plain: Mutates Balances[account], draws 8 random bytes via env.Read, and emits ledger.entries.

nodes.title: reject
nodes.plain: Emits a rejection record without modifying balances.

nodes.title: Ledger.Net
nodes.plain: Running total of deposits minus withdrawals.

nodes.title: ledger.entries
nodes.plain: Emitted Entry JSON for each posted debit/credit.

nodes.title: ledger.rejections
nodes.plain: Emitted Rejection JSON for insufficient funds or invalid amounts.

nodes.title: balances_non_negative
nodes.plain: Every account balance in Ledger.Balances remains >= 0 after every step.

nodes.title: Nil *ev.Amount dereference
nodes.plain: Dereferences *ev.Amount unconditionally before checking ev.Amount == nil.
nodes.detail: In unpatched builds, amount := *ev.Amount panics with nil pointer dereference; partialFix only guards deposits.

flows.title: Null amount crash
flows.plain: Walks evt-008 (seq 32) from null JSON input to the nil-pointer panic.

steps.text: evt-008 arrives at seq 32 with type "deposit" and "amount": null.
Ledger.Handle decodes Event into ev where ev.Amount is nil.
Line 57 executes amount := *ev.Amount without a nil guard and panics.
Because the step panics, declared invariants are skipped and the recorder flushes the fixture.
